text:
alex: FYI I pushed quantized v2 for the test-runner. Scorecard shows embedding-sim drop in cohort 'support-chat' for model-quant-v2. Anyone else see this?

maria: Yep, saw it. Delta ~ -0.12 median cosine vs baseline. Only for short messages <16 tokens.

jin: CI-runner logs show tokenizer returned weird <unk> tokens for some samples. Maybe quantization remapped vocab indices.

alex: Re-ran locally, same. Runner snippet:
```
2026-03-18T13:12:33Z runner: sample_id=4821 tokens=[CLS] hello <unk> world
2026-03-18T13:12:33Z tokenizer: token_ids=[101, 9999, 1000, 2088]
2026-03-18T13:12:33Z embed: vector_norm=0.0
```

ops-bot: buildbot: runner-ci/test-678 failed on model-quant-v2 (diff threshold exceeded).

tina: Might be metric definition. We're using mean cosine across all samples; zeros from <unk> pull median down for small cohorts. Suggest trimmed mean or applying a valid_token_ratio filter.

sam: Agree. Also add cohort-level sample count guard and annotate dashboard with 'n<50' warning.

maria: Also, quantized outputs have longer whitespace tokens which affects embedding normalizer. Quick mitigation: L2-normalize embeddings before average.

alex: Plan: (1) update runner to compute valid_token_ratio + l2norm embeddings; (2) change dashboard to show trimmed_mean(5%) + annotate low-n cohorts; (3) re-run CI with extra seeds. Will push PR.

alex: PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/943|add token-ratio and norm>

jin: Also add a per-sample histogram panel in console drilldown to catch these shifts earlier. I can prototype the UI patch.

tina: Ops asks to gate Dedicated/Private deploys when cohort drift > 0.08. Can we add that rule?

ops-bot: incident-bot: alert created #inc-4388 cohort-drift-threshold for model-quant-v2

sam: :thumbsup: I'll queue rerun once PR passes. Alex ping me when ready.

alex: PR up and CI queued. If it still fails we'll roll back to quant-v1 for the release.
